name: The Broken-Orbit Ruins
introDiscord: An ancient celestial machine lies broken across the trench. Rings rotate backward, gears orbit things they are supposed to be attached to, and the Sentinels somehow still expect everything to work.
introTwitch: An ancient celestial machine lies broken across the trench. Rings rotate backward, gears orbit things they are supposed to be attached to, and the Sentinels somehow still expect everything to work.

the-broken-orbit-ruins-approach.prompt: Three routes wind through malfunctioning celestial machinery.

left.message: A Broken-Orbit Sentinel activates, looks at a disconnected gear, looks at you, and apparently decides you are easier to fix.

right.message: A meteor-iron reliquary lies inside a broken mechanism.

forward.message: Shizuki's tonic reads: "Machine repair attempt #1. I hit it. Machine became louder."
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the tonic and resist contributing to the repair effort.

the-broken-orbit-ruins-depths.prompt: Rotating rings cross three passages at completely incorrect angles.

left.message: A cometglass seam has been exposed by a gear that escaped its machine.

right.message: A Sentinel attempts to restore order by attacking the only thing not currently malfunctioning: you.

forward.message:
A Berry rests beside Shizuki's repair log:

"Attempt #4:
Asked Glimmer.
Glimmer chimed.
Machine stopped.
I am choosing to call this engineering."

the-broken-orbit-ruins-threshold.prompt: Shattered Orrery turns unevenly beyond three final paths.

left.message: Shizuki's bottle is tucked beneath a sign reading: "Maintenance staff unavailable forever."
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the maintenance medicine alone.

right.message: A star-chart coffer sits inside the broken orrery.

forward.message:
"A Sentinel blocks the final path while one of its own gears slowly floats away behind it."

BOSS:

bossPromptDiscord:
The Shattered Orrery suddenly aligns.

A much larger Sentinel activates at its center.

Use /yes to approach or /no to leave before the machine discovers another creative malfunction.
bossPromptTwitch:
The Shattered Orrery suddenly aligns.

A much larger Sentinel activates at its center.

Use !yes to approach or !no to leave before the machine discovers another creative malfunction.
bossRetreatText: You retreat. The orrery immediately breaks alignment again.

boss.revealText:
The central mechanism locks into place.

Aphelion Sentinel awakens!

completionText:
"The Sentinel falls silent.

The machinery continues malfunctioning peacefully.

Repair successful enough."
